name: ScrollArea
purpose: Scroll container for the task list and the trash list. The task list is also a drop target. Scroll is native; the widget sets the axis and whether the scrollbar shows.
base: Radix ScrollArea (shadcn ScrollArea) when the bar is visible; plain overflow when hidden

values.when: Task list and trash list body. Every recorded use.
Horizontal scroll. Not used by any widget here: the list tab strip is TabList with overflow scroll, which is the same look as A's ScrollArea horizontal hidden.
Scrollbar hidden; scrolls with wheel and trackpad. Not used by ScrollArea in the catalogue (TabList covers the tab strip); kept for parity.
No fill. Task list and trash list.
bg-surface-2 with text-content-2. Scroll region on a raised surface, such as the lightbox text preview (AttachmentPreview text kind).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; makes the region labelled.

props.name: dropTarget
props.description: Task list: drop onto blank space moves the task to the list root.

props.name: onPressBlank
props.description: Task list: a press on blank space (not a data-task-id row) clears selection and focus.

role: region when labelled; none otherwise. Scrollable regions get tabIndex 0 when they overflow (proposed).
keyboard: Native scroll keys when focused: arrows, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End; mouse wheel and trackpad. Drop target: pointer drag only in the catalogue, with edge auto-scroll.
open: Dropped duplicates: A's 'list tab strip' is TabList; B's 'settings content pane' is TabPanel; B's 'command palette results list' is CommandList; B's 'lightbox text preview' is AttachmentPreview. Task list scrollbar visibility is not recorded; assumed native. Edge auto-scroll while dragging is the task list's behaviour. Keyboard reorder to the list root has no path in the catalogue.
